description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.
